verdict.rationale: Codegen's API/SDK let you programmatically create, run, and list many agent runs (with per-user filtering) and trigger agents from CI/CD, which supports running multiple tasks concurrently at an engineering-lead level. However, there is no explicit documentation of concurrency limits, throughput guarantees, or dashboards for managing large numbers of simultaneous runs. missing for 10: explicit concurrency/scale limits or benchmarks, independent evidence of running many agents at once, org-level throughput/queue management docs.
